'''Avoira''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who was sold into slavery on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], she, along with [[Jurithus]], [[Rennith]], and [[Sathun]], joined a group of slave rebels to fight against their Imperial slavers and escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, she and her friends were all killed in the skirmish.
